cross_record_findings: Historical evidence ranges from research inventories and rulebook proposals through isolated runtime candidates; completion at one layer does not imply current shared integration, source qualification, or human acceptance.

Persistence claims are especially scope-sensitive: RAM probes, same-origin export/import, candidate save cycles and shared production behavior establish different evidence, and the checkpoints name those boundaries.
Several records retain later steering or source drift that supersedes earlier next steps, notably the UI pause and livelihood source delta; checkpoints must be read chronologically before reuse.
